description: Implementation of the SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase class managing SQLite database operations, including initialization, schema migration, error handling, and background task management within the net namespace.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A class managing SQLite database backend operations including initialization, schema migration, error handling, and background task execution within the net namespace.

methods.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the backend with database path, version info, task runners, and access mode.

methods.name: ~SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
methods.description: Destructor ensuring proper cleanup and checking that close was called.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes pending database operations and executes a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database, either immediately if called from the background thread or by posting a task.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be run before committing database changes.

methods.name: InitializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating directories, opening the database, and migrating schema.

methods.name: DoInitializeDatabase
methods.description: Performs additional initialization steps; default implementation returns true.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the database and metadata, closing connections.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits pending changes, executing the before-commit callback if set.

methods.name: PostBackgroundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the background task runner.

methods.name: PostClientTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the client task runner.

methods.name: MigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Handles database schema migration and recovery if needed.

methods.name: FlushAndNotifyInBackground
methods.description: Performs commit and notifies via callback in background.

methods.name: DoCloseInBackground
methods.description: Performs cleanup and closing operations in background.

methods.name: DatabaseErrorCallback
methods.description: Handles database errors, triggers database kill on catastrophic errors.

methods.name: KillDatabase
methods.description: Razes and poisons the database, marking it as in-memory only.
